story_title: The Elevator Opened on a Floor That Didn't Exist
premise: Every night at 2:13 AM, an elevator stops at the nonexistent 13th floor of an apartment tower. Inside, a tenant discovers a duplicate hallway, a double wearing his red beanie, and a terrifying phone notification.
opening_hook: I live on the 12th floor. And every night, at exactly 2:13 AM, my elevator stops at the 13th.

characters.name: The Wanderer
characters.visual_anchor: 2D graphic-novel stickman protagonist with smooth warm ivory oval head, two vertical black pill eyes, neutral slit mouth, thin black stick limbs and torso, wearing a brick-red ribbed knit beanie, striped mustard-gold and rust-maroon scarf with fringe, and dark charcoal short-sleeved t-shirt.
characters.motivation: Escape the duplicate floor and survive the entity in his apartment.

scenes.title: The 2:13 AM Anomaly
scenes.narration: I live on the 12th floor. And every night, at exactly 2:13 AM, my elevator stops at the 13th. The problem? My building doesn't have a 13th floor. At first, I thought it was a glitch. Until one night, I decided to stay inside and see what happened.
scenes.visual_description: Vertical 9:16 portrait. The Wanderer standing inside a vintage brass elevator cab watching glowing red floor indicator lights as the elevator ascends past 12.

scenes.title: The Duplicate Hallway
scenes.narration: The elevator stopped. The doors opened. And outside was a hallway that looked exactly like mine. Same wallpaper. Same lights. Same apartment doors. Except every door had my apartment number. I pressed the close button. Nothing happened.
scenes.visual_description: Vertical 9:16 portrait. The elevator doors sliding open to reveal a narrow repeating hallway with flickering sconces and identical door numbers repeating into darkness.

scenes.title: The Red Beanie at the Staircase
scenes.narration: Then I noticed something at the end of the hallway. A person standing beside the staircase. Wearing a red beanie. My red beanie. I stepped backward. The person started walking toward the elevator. I pressed every button. Nothing. Then the elevator speaker crackled. A voice whispered: 'Don't let him enter.'
scenes.visual_description: Vertical 9:16 portrait. Silhouetted stickman figure at the far end of the hallway wearing an identical brick-red beanie stepping forward with unnatural robotic gait.

scenes.title: Inside Behind Me
scenes.narration: The doors finally began closing. But just before they shut, I saw something that made my entire body freeze. The person wasn't walking toward me anymore. He was standing inside the elevator. Behind me. I turned around. Nobody was there.
scenes.visual_description: Vertical 9:16 portrait. Extreme close-up on The Wanderer's ivory face with vertical black pill eyes wide in terror, mirrored reflection in elevator chrome showing a shadowy duplicate figure directly behind him.

scenes.title: The Wrong Floor
scenes.narration: The elevator reached the 12th floor. I ran to my apartment and locked the door. I thought it was over. Until I checked my phone. There was a new security notification: Motion detected inside your apartment. I opened the camera. And there I was. Sitting on my bed. Wearing my red beanie. But I was watching the recording from outside. And the person sitting on my bed slowly turned toward the camera. He whispered: 'You're on the wrong floor.' Would you enter that elevator again?
scenes.visual_description: Vertical 9:16 portrait. The Wanderer standing outside his door holding glowing smartphone showing black-and-white night-vision bedroom camera feed where his duplicate turns to stare directly at the lens.
